A companion for a MeshCore or Meshtastic radio. Messages go over Bluetooth to the radio beside you and out through the mesh.
Nothing here touches the internet. There is no account, no server and no carrier — only the radio, and whatever it can reach.
Messages that arrive while this is closed wait on the radio and appear when you open it. Nothing here runs in the background, and nothing interrupts you.
GNU General Public License v3 only
MeshCore\'s protocol, implemented from reading its source. MeshCore itself is MIT and none of it is copied here.
Meshtastic\'s protocol definitions, unchanged, GPL-3.0, © Meshtastic LLC. The radio does the encryption.
A radio\'s firmware is updated on a computer, with the Meshtastic web flasher or its documentation, not from Mesh. QR codes are drawn with ZXing, Apache 2.0.
